{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Impcourier.jpg|thumb|250px|right|An Imperial courier]]
{{Quote|These papers are from Central Command, sir.|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] courier|<ref name="GH">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Imperial Courier}}</ref>}}
A '''courier''' was a person or a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] intended for delivery of urgent cargo and passengers and was thus built for speed rather than combat.

==Characteristics==
Courier ships could range in size from small, one- or two-man ships like those that ferried [[Jedi courier 1101|Yoshi Raph-Elan]] and [[B'dard Tone's courier|B'dard Tone]] to their destinations, all the way up to larger ships like the [[YKL-37R Nova Courier|YKL-37R Nova]] and [[BR-23 courier|BR-23]] that could transport troops and bulk cargo. In addition, courier ships were often well-armed to provide security for their important shipments.

Most courier ships were built with speed as the biggest consideration, with no much attention paid to the interior facilities, resulting to uncomfortable conditions to pilots and passengers.<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

There were also courier droids that could deliver messages or small cargo shipments from point to point or across the galaxy if need be.

Sentients worked as couriers in certain circumstances.<ref name="cp">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref><ref name="Retreat from Coruscant">{{JournalCite|7|Retreat from Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="GH" />
